  2. The clinic **maintains an Active Biomedical Waste Handling Permit**.

The policy contains **no "or"** alternatives, so there is a single group with the two conditions above.

  This indirectly implies clinical operational status (institutional readiness for complex clinical operations is a typical prerequisite). Hence **m_00cf43** satisfies this condition.

- **Condition 2:** "maintains an Active Biomedical Waste Handling Permit"

  This directly satisfies the condition.

No other candidate directly states "clinical operational status," so **m_00cf43** is the best match. All other candidates discuss unrelated aspects (e.g., funding, EHR deployment, privacy compliance, staffing ratios, etc.) and do not fulfill either requirement.
